Bulk AI is a very useful app for Shopify store owners. It helps generate and manage product content quickly and saves a lot of time when working with many products. The interface is simple and easy to use, and the results are surprisingly good. It’s especially helpful for optimizing product descriptions and improving store efficiency. Definitely recommended for anyone managing a large catalog on Shopify.
